PostToolUse.command: FILE="$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT_file_path"; if [[ "$FILE" == */backend/*.ts ]]; then cd /Users/jasonkopacz/osmosis && npm run typecheck -w backend --silent 2>&1 | tail -15; elif [[ "$FILE" == */extension/*.ts ]]; then cd /Users/jasonkopacz/osmosis && npm run typecheck -w extension --silent 2>&1 | tail -15; fi; exit 0
PostToolUse.description: TypeScript check for the workspace matching the edited file

PostToolUse.command: FILE="$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT_file_path"; if [[ "$FILE" == *.ts ]] && grep -nE '\.style\.(cssText|color|background|fontSize|display|flex|padding|margin|border|borderRadius|gap|width|height|position|top|left|right|bottom|font)' "$FILE" 2>/dev/null | grep -v '//'; then echo "[CSS Rule] VIOLATION: static inline style found in $FILE — use a CSS class instead"; fi; exit 0
PostToolUse.description: Warn when static inline styles are written in TypeScript files
